phase3_core_k.note: Core K counts drawable cards crossing a hard 3x pack-equivalent-cost threshold -- an integer step function, unlike Accessibility's continuous A_raw. Non-zero share_changed at even small (+-2%) shocks with zero A_raw sensitivity (Phase 5/6) at the same magnitudes quantifies exactly this discontinuity gap.
